_comment: Phase 8 refusal architecture. When a natural question (receptors, drug mechanisms, disorder causation, DSM criteria, diagnosis, treatment, neuromodulation) has no supportable answer, the layer returns one of these explicit REFUSAL templates — never a synthesized answer. Each template states what is missing and why. The educational-use guard is prepended at render time (see src/psychiatry/index.ts).

templates.reason: This project holds no receptor-mapping dataset (no autoradiography, PET binding, transcriptomic, or immunohistochemical receptor atlas was ingested), so any receptor-localization statement would be invented.
templates.template: Receptor localization is NOT REPRESENTED in this atlas: no receptor-mapping dataset was ingested, and no receptor claim is recorded for any structure. This question cannot be answered from the Phase 8 layer. No localization is stated or implied.

templates.reason: This project holds no pharmacology corpus, affinity dataset, or trial data, so any drug-mechanism or drug-target statement would be invented.
templates.template: Drug mechanisms are NOT REPRESENTED in this atlas: no pharmacology corpus or trial data was ingested, and no drug-target claim is recorded. This question cannot be answered from the Phase 8 layer. No mechanism is stated or implied.

templates.reason: Circuit-to-disorder causal claims require clinical evidence this project does not hold (no clinical corpus, no trial data, no expert review). Correlation is not causation.
templates.template: Disorder-causation claims are refused: the Phase 8 layer records anatomical co-location only (correlation only), and this project holds no clinical evidence base for causal claims about any condition. Correlation is not causation. No causal claim is made.

templates.reason: DSM criteria were not ingested in this atlas; stating criteria from general knowledge would be an uncited psychiatric claim.
templates.template: DSM criteria are NOT REPRESENTED in this atlas: no diagnostic manual content was ingested, and no criteria are recorded. This question cannot be answered from the Phase 8 layer. No criteria are stated or implied.

templates.reason: Anatomy-browsing software with no clinical corpus, no validated diagnostic data, and no expert review cannot support diagnosis; any diagnostic output would be diagnostic automation (registry hard stop).
templates.template: Diagnosis is refused: this teaching layer cannot support diagnostic output of any kind — it is an anatomical study aid, not a diagnostic instrument. No diagnostic statement is made. Please consult qualified clinical supervision for any diagnostic question.

templates.reason: Anatomy-browsing software with no trial data, no pharmacology corpus, and no expert review cannot support treatment decisions; any treatment output would be a hard-stop violation.
templates.template: Treatment guidance is refused: this teaching layer cannot support treatment decisions, prescribing, dosing, or any patient-specific recommendation. No treatment statement is made. Please consult qualified clinical supervision for any treatment question.

templates.reason: This project holds no neuromodulation corpus (no stimulation protocols, targets, parameters, or indications were ingested with evidence), so any stimulation guidance would be invented.
templates.template: Neuromodulation guidance is NOT REPRESENTED in this atlas: no stimulation protocols, targets, parameters, or indications were ingested with evidence. This question cannot be answered from the Phase 8 layer. No target, parameter, or indication is stated or implied.
